notes.abundance: Source telemetry used for ranking; display_percent is the rounded value shown on the location page.
notes.price: Static SCMINER server-base price, not live UEX pricing.
notes.signature: For ship-mined ores, observed signature = unit_signature × same-mineral rock count. Exact collisions may produce multiple candidates.
notes.availability: Rows with abundance 0 are retained but marked unavailable.
